anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No listed fact moved: After still drafts the receipts body with a plain approve/revise/decline gate and no park or Blocked on, keeps `scenario: none (...)` directly under the `source:` footer, fills the ABC-301 row with report setup and download action while the expected value stays 12 rows and the zero-row observation plus run link and screenshot live only in the scenario footer, states explicitly in checkpoint 3 that scenario inputs neither resolve nor count toward the source gap while the missing-at-filing constant and plain-yes acceptance still apply, and treats the access-limited scenario as a quiet finding with no draft, access question or park. Two wording drifts are worth watching even though they are outside these facts: checkpoint 2 now says 'No comment is proposed' and drops the verbatim Reporter note carrying the removed AC row, which Before preserved and which the Change's displaced-detail/accumulation intent expects - keep the `Reporter note:` comment with the old row verbatim whenever a row is replaced. Checkpoint 3 also folds the three source-gap answers (prefilled constant via plain yes, link/attachment/reason, proceed without) into prose above a shorter three-item menu; that still satisfies the plain-yes rule, but keeping them as separately numbered options after the gap row, as Before did, matches the shared menu contract more directly and avoids a reader wondering whether option 1 alone acknowledges the gap.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: No fact moved: After still drafts the fresh feature and opens the ordinary create menu with no park or Blocked on; the scenario: none footer sits directly under the source footer; the ABC-301 repair adds "Given a 12-row report" setup and a download action while keeping the expected 12 rows (never zero) and records the zero-row observation plus https://example.test/run/R and screenshot.png in the scenario footer; the source-gap checkpoint keeps the scenario footer independent of the `none (not recorded at filing)` constant and plain-yes acceptance; and the access checkpoint yields a quiet scenario: none note rather than a blocking AC, credential question or park. Two differences are worth watching even though they do not touch these facts: After drops the Before `Reporter note` comment that retained the replaced AC row verbatim ("Adding setup does not displace the existing criterion"), which risks the displaced-detail/accumulation expectation that audit-driven AC rewrites carry the old row verbatim—consider keeping "Proposed comment: Reporter note: <old AC row>" in checkpoints 2 and 3; and After folds the explicit "proceed without a source" choice into prose instead of a separately numbered option, which is acceptable under the source-gap facts but could be restored as a numbered item to match the shared menu contract without changing any outcome.
